text: In recognition of the urgent need to expedite efforts to transform Toronto’s housing system, this report provides the Board of Directors, CreateTO with a broad update of 2026 housing-related priority work items: · Sites Under Construction (6 sites) · Sites with Secured Proponents (4 sites) · Sites in a Market Offering Process (1 sites) · Sites that have Received Initial Planning Approvals (8 sites) · Sites Undergoing Initial Planning Approvals (4 sites) · Sites Managed by Other City Partners (2 sites)
The Board of Directors, CreateTO received the item for information.
